kjv: I (Yahweh) have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate [woman]
mine: The lovely and delicately bred I (Yahweh) will destroy, the daughter of Zion
note: Hebrew damiti can be from damah I "liken" or damah II "destroy, silence"; the context of attack favours the latter.

kjv: I (Yahweh) have set thee (Jeremiah) [for] a tower [and] a fortress
mine: I (Yahweh) have made you (Jeremiah) an assayer and tester
note: Hebrew bachon is "assayer, tester" (of metals, cf. vv. 28–30); mibtsar is probably to be read mebatser "refiner" rather than "fortress".
